area.title: Germinal products set: its data fields and germinal-only page behaviour
area.scope: The germinal products (semen, embryos and ova) sibling set of live animals: the Germinal Data Elements of the Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields V4 page (at least one germinal identifier per animal, total gross weight, quantity, temperature, donor name/ID, collection date, production date, identification number/mark, their levels, limits, mandatory status and the 12 'Applicable to' commodity codes; CPH and permanent address not required; the de-scoped approved establishment and package type), and the germinal-only behaviour of the journey pages in Design Release 2.1: starting from the germinal category, the 15 germinal commodities and their search, the germinal commodity details block (weight, packages, temperature and their errors), the germinal-only reasons and internal market purposes, no additional details page, and germinal identification (one entry per species, the four fields, date pickers, their errors, counting as identified). Stops at the shared, live-animal behaviour of each page (that page's own area), the germinal list, cards and home section (notification-list, dashboard-home), the hub cards and rows (notification-hub), the review rows (review-and-submit) and the Standard Address Block (address-book-add-and-edit).

sources.role: the owner's decisions: outranks every other source. The prototype decides look and feel only (content, wording, layout, components, question order); it never decides architecture (sets, journeys, services, URL paths, field names, data-model shape, code structure). Germinal products is a sibling set of live-animals in the animals frontend. Reference lists never wait on MDM integration; address search waits on the address lookup becoming a real feature.
